prompt: Rendered in the style of oil painting, a vibrant rooftop party unfolds under a starry sky. On the far left, a woman in a silk dress leans against a stone railing, her gaze fixed on the horizon. Next to her stands a man in a red scarf, holding a crystal flute filled with champagne. In the center foreground, a brown dog sits patiently beside a wooden crate, watching the festivities with alert eyes. A teenager in a denim jacket points excitedly toward the city skyline, drawing the attention of a girl in a yellow hat who looks at him with curiosity. Behind them, a chef in a white apron hands a plate of appetizers to a guest in a blue suit, who reaches out eagerly to accept the offering. To the right, an elderly man in a tweed cap sits on a folding chair, sipping from a ceramic mug. Beside him, a cat with orange fur sleeps curled up on a cushion, undisturbed by the noise. A musician in a black vest strums an acoustic guitar, his fingers moving deftly over the strings. A dancer in a sequined top spins nearby, her arms raised in joy. A couple shares a quiet moment; the man in a leather jacket looks at the woman in a floral skirt, who smiles back warmly. A waiter in a gray uniform carries a tray of drinks, navigating carefully through the crowd. A child in a striped shirt chases a red balloon that floats just above their head. A photographer in a beige coat adjusts the lens of a large camera, capturing the scene. Finally, a bartender in a black shirt mixes cocktails behind a portable bar, ice clinking in the shaker. There is no swimming pool visible on this urban terrace. There is no snow falling from the clear night sky.
